titles.romaji: Dokidoki Oyako Lesson: Oshiete♪ H na Obenkyou
titles.native: ドキドキ母娘レッスン～教えて♪Hなお勉強～

description:
Based on the erotic game by TinkerBell.

Shio Atsushi is a professor who will provide home class to two daughters of different families: Arisa and Maya.
But it seems this won't be only educational purpose since the two girls show interest to that man.
